bundle_dir.description: Base directory for OCI bundle data (runtime-generated files, state, etc.).

rootfs.description: Default root filesystem path for containers when not specified in container config.

seccomp.description: Enable or disable seccomp syscall filtering for containers.

apparmor.description: Enable or disable AppArmor mandatory access control for containers (Linux only).

selinux.description: Enable or disable SELinux labeling for containers (Linux only).

capabilities.description: Enable or disable POSIX capabilities management for containers.

seccomp_profile.description: Path to the JSON file defining allowed/denied syscalls when seccomp is enabled.

apparmor_profile.description: Name of the AppArmor profile to apply to containers when AppArmor is enabled.

selinux_label.description: Default SELinux label to apply to container processes and files when SELinux is enabled.

cap_drop.description: List of capabilities to drop by default in all containers (e.g., ['CAP_SYS_ADMIN']).

cap_add.description: List of additional capabilities to grant to containers (e.g., ['NET_BIND_SERVICE']).

default_uid.description: Default UID used for the container's init process when no user is specified.

default_gid.description: Default GID used for the container's init process when no group is specified.

crio_compatibility.description: Enable compatibility mode for CRI-O (e.g., handle CRI-specific annotations).

podman_compatibility.description: Enable compatibility mode for Podman (e.g., support Podman-specific config keys).

log_path.description: Path to the log file. Empty string disables file logging (stdout only).

log_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) per log file before rotation.

log_files.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

systemd_cgroup.description: Use systemd for cgroup management instead of cgroupfs (requires systemd).

cgroup_manager.description: Cgroup driver: 'systemd' or 'cgroupfs'. Used only if systemd_cgroup is false.

annotations.description: Key-value pairs added to container metadata (e.g., for debugging or automation).

prestart_hooks.description: Commands to run before the container process starts (e.g., setup scripts).

path.description: Absolute path to the hook executable

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the hook (list of strings)

poststop_hooks.description: Commands to run after the container stops (e.g., cleanup scripts).

path.description: Absolute path to the hook executable

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the hook (list of strings)
